description: I’m gonna be doing abandoned but not forgotten
summary:
Abandoned But Not Forgotten is an interactive digital story project about NASA equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. Our solution, Off-World Time Capsule, turns these old spacecraft and scientific equipment into short, interactive mission stories. Users can explore why the equipment was sent, what it did, what scientists learned from it, and why it still matters today.

The project uses examples such as the Spirit and Opportunity rovers, the InSight lander, and the Apollo 15 ALSEP experiments. It shows that equipment left behind is not simply forgotten. Each object is connected to discoveries, challenges, and lessons that helped future missions. Our goal is to make these stories easier and more interesting for students and the public to explore.
details:
Our project, Off-World Time Capsule, is a digital interactive experience that tells the stories behind NASA equipment left on the Moon and Mars. Users can explore each mission through five parts: Origin, Journey, Work, Evidence, and Legacy. They can also use interactive features such as an Evidence Detective, Mission Decision, and Mission Card.

The project helps people understand that equipment left behind can still have an important story and scientific value. We use real NASA mission information about Spirit, Opportunity, InSight, and Apollo 15 ALSEP. The main goal is to make space exploration history more interesting and easier for students and the public to understand.

The project was designed as a web-based concept using digital storytelling, interactive learning, and visual mission cards. AI was used to help with research and developing the written content and project ideas. The creative focus was turning technical mission information into a simple story that people can explore instead of just reading a list of facts.
